all_and_residential_totals_oracle.sql: select sum(m.upload),sum(m.download),count(distinct m.session_pk),count(distinct m.utc_minute),sum(case when (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) then m.upload else 0 end),sum(case when (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) then m.download else 0 end),count(distinct case when (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) then m.session_pk end),count(distinct case when (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) then m.utc_minute end) from connection_minute m join connection_session s on s.session_pk=m.session_pk left join connection_session_attr a on a.session_pk=s.session_pk where m.utc_minute>=? and m.utc_minute<?

residential_host_rank_oracle.sql: select coalesce(nullif(s.host,''),'__unknown__') as identity,sum(m.upload),sum(m.download),count(distinct m.session_pk),count(distinct m.utc_minute)*60 from connection_minute m join connection_session s on s.session_pk=m.session_pk left join connection_session_attr a on a.session_pk=s.session_pk where m.utc_minute>=? and m.utc_minute<? and (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) group by identity order by sum(m.download) desc,identity asc limit ?

residential_network_rank_oracle.sql: select coalesce(nullif(d.value,''),'__unknown__') as identity,sum(m.upload),sum(m.download),count(distinct m.session_pk),count(distinct m.utc_minute)*60 from connection_minute m join connection_session s on s.session_pk=m.session_pk left join connection_session_attr a on a.session_pk=s.session_pk left join dimension_dict d on d.dimension_kind='network' and d.dimension_id=a.network_id where m.utc_minute>=? and m.utc_minute<? and (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) group by identity order by sum(m.download) desc,identity asc limit ?
